units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:42">Targ. O. Lev. XIV, 42</cite> <he>וִישׁוּעַ</he> (Kimḥi <he>וִישִׁיעַ</he>, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 35; some ed. <he>ויסוע</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 27:2">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVII, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 27:4">4</cite>.
Targ. Ez. XIII, 12; a. e.—Part. pass. שִׁיעַ smooth.
<cite ref="Chullin 47b">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>דמיא לאופתא</he>) <he>יעָא דלית וכ׳ שֻׁד</he> when the lung is a smooth-surfaced mass, without incisions marking the lobes.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 22:11">Targ. Y. Deut. XXII, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47b:16">Ab. Zar. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>דש׳ והדר שַׁיְּיעֵיה</he> when he plastered once and plastered it over again.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> [read:] <he>אתי למֵישַׁיַּיע תרתין והוא שייע ארבע</he> one came to plaster two (squares of a wall), and he plastered four; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:8">Yalk. ib. 62</cite> <he>אתי למֵישַׁע חדא והוא שייע ארבע</he>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:43">Targ. O. Lev. XIV, 43</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:48">48</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="U01677"><he>אִתָּשַׁע</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U01677"><he>שְׁעַע</he></cite>).
